response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(powerstatus, 'MISSING') as powerstatus, COUNT(*) as count FROM telescopes GROUP BY COALESCE(powerstatus, 'MISSING')), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM status_counts), with_percentages AS (SELECT sc.powerstatus, sc.count, (sc.count * 100.0 / tc.total) as share_percent FROM status_counts sc CROSS JOIN total_count tc), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share_percent) as avg_share_pct FROM with_percentages), above_average AS (SELECT wp.powerstatus, wp.count, wp.share_percent, av.avg_share_pct FROM with_percentages wp CROSS JOIN avg_share av WHERE wp.share_percent > av.avg_share_pct) SELECT SUM(count) as total_telescopes, AVG(share_percent) as average_share, AVG(share_percent - avg_share_pct) as avg_amount_above_average FROM above_average

assumptions.assumption: NULL or missing powerstatus values are grouped as a distinct category labeled 'MISSING'
